scene_sentence_zh: 野溪自深色花崗岩崖壁直落入乳藍色的天然岩池，水霧與冷冽的飛沫在濕黑的石面上浮動。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a wild mountain waterfall dropping from a dark granite cliff into a natural rock basin of milky turquoise water, wet black stone and fern ledges, cold spray and drifting mist, the basin ringed by rough natural boulders and pale gravel, a bare rock ledge across the foreground

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: A painterly JRPG wild waterfall dropping from a dark granite cliff into a natural rock basin of milky turquoise water, cold spray and drifting mist, fern ledges on the wet black stone, rough boulders and pale gravel around the pool and a bare rock ledge across the foreground. No figure, no creature, no readable lettering; the fall and cliff occupy the upper two thirds.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop: the full-bleed composition holds at 1451x790: the waterfall and cliff keep the upper band while the rock ledge stays open for stage figures.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed on a ten-up contact sheet of the whole rite pack: each archetype reads as its own place — spring basin, stag statue, stone circle, sea tower, tree hollow, grave rows, crystal mine, sandstone arch, waterfall basin and capital plaza — with a consistent painterly palette and no two compositions alike.
